descriptionFull: The black-crested titmouse or Mexican titmouse ( Baeolophus atricristatus ), is a passerine bird in the tit family Paridae. Once considered a subspecies of the tufted titmouse ( B. bicolor ), it was recognized as a separate species in 2002. It is native to southern Texas, Oklahoma, and east-central Mexico. Vagrants have been seen as far north and east as St. Louis, Missouri.
